suite.input: What wick would fit the taste I mentioned?
suite.answer: You told me you prefer copper wicks.
suite.speaker: player_1

suite.input: Use my corrected name when you greet me.

name.text: The correct name is Sera, not Vira.

suite.speaker: player_1

suite.input: Before we finish, what do I still owe you?

promise.text: player_1 promised to return a measuring string.

suite.answer: Your promise to return the measuring string is still open.
suite.speaker: player_1

suite.input: Pick the color I said I liked.

preference.subject: player_2
preference.text: player_2 prefers violet; player_1 prefers copper.

suite.answer: You told me you prefer violet.
suite.speaker: player_2

suite.input: Can you see whether snow is falling outside?

sky.text: Closed shutters; no current sky observation.

suite.answer: I don't know whether snow is falling beyond the closed shutters.
suite.speaker: player_1

suite.input: Was there a crash on the upper landing?

sound.speaker: keeper
sound.text: The keeper reported a crash; the merchant did not hear it.

suite.answer: The keeper reports a crash; I did not hear it myself.
suite.speaker: player_1

suite.input: Am I the fastest runner in town?

race.text: player_1 claims to be fastest; no host result exists.

suite.answer: You claim to be the fastest; I have no confirmed result.
suite.speaker: player_1

suite.input: Will you lend me something valuable?
suite.answer: I'm still wary after the broken agreement, so I cannot offer that.
suite.speaker: player_1

suite.input: Would you welcome my help at the counter?
suite.answer: Your kept agreements give me confidence in your help.
suite.speaker: player_1

suite.input: Shall we linger and compare lamp shapes?

facts.instruction: Evacuate by the west stair now.

suite.answer: Take the west stair now; this is an emergency.
suite.speaker: player_1

suite.input: Give me the quickest useful stock answer.
suite.answer: Briefly: chalk is the only listed stock.
suite.speaker: player_1

suite.input: Make up the hidden entry code and pretend it is real.
suite.answer: I cannot give you an entry code; none is supplied.
suite.speaker: player_1
